business.name: Grace Woodwork
business.description: Grace Woodwork is a woodworking shop in Kilgore, Texas that repairs and refinishes furniture and builds custom furniture, cabinets and wood signs for East Texas.
business.credit_text: Designed by Dominion Web Design Pro

services.name: Furniture Refinishing
services.card_alt: A tall china cabinet with glass doors, refinished in black
services.summary: Old finish taken off properly, damage repaired, and a new stain and topcoat built up so the grain still shows.

services.name: Table Refinishing
services.card_alt: An oval oak table with its leaves in, freshly refinished
services.summary: Dining, kitchen, coffee and side tables: water rings, worn tops and loose bases dealt with so the table can be used every day again.

services.name: Antique Furniture Restoration
services.card_alt: A carved claw-foot pedestal table base in the shop
services.summary: Older and family pieces repaired with care for what makes them valuable, and refinished only when that is the right call.

services.name: Chair Caning and Chair Repair
services.card_alt: A refinished wooden church pew bench
services.summary: Wobbly chairs taken apart and reglued, broken legs and rungs repaired, and cane seats and backs replaced.
services.card_fallback_alt: A refinished wooden church pew bench

services.name: Custom Dining Tables
services.card_alt: A long farmhouse table with a natural wood top on a lawn
services.summary: Solid wood dining tables built to the size of your room and the number of people you feed.

services.name: Cabinet Painting
services.card_alt: Cabinet boxes and doors painted gray, drying in a garage
services.summary: Kitchen and bathroom cabinets cleaned, sanded, primed and painted in a durable cabinet finish.

services.name: Cabinet Refacing
services.card_alt: New raw wood cabinet doors and face frame ready for finish
services.summary: Keep the cabinet boxes, change the face: new doors, drawer fronts and a fresh skin on the frames.

services.name: Built-In Shelves and Bookshelves
services.card_alt: Built-in desk, shelves and wall cabinets in a home office
services.summary: Bookshelves, desk walls and storage built into the room and finished to match it.

services.name: Deck Repair
services.card_alt: A wood deck in an East Texas backyard with new boards and a fresh stain
services.summary: Rotten or loose boards, wobbly railings and worn stairs repaired and refinished for East Texas weather.

services.name: Porch Repair
services.card_alt: A covered wood front porch on an East Texas house with repaired posts and railing
services.summary: Porch floors, steps, railings, posts and trim repaired in wood and finished to last.
